source_note: Fail-closed, build-free cross-check for stage 3: the Material document-tab STRIP (SfxDocumentTabBar). The strip is a svtools::TabBar subclass that rides the already-shipped Material TabBar paint path (the calc-sheet-tabs anatomy) and, on tab activation, RAISES each document's existing top-level window via the EXACT frame-activation path the Window menu uses -- it never hosts multiple documents in one window and never performs a topness-violating cast. Everything is guarded behind the stage-2 officecfg TabsEnabled property (default false): the widget cannot even be constructed when tabs are off, so the default build stays byte-identical. The checker re-derives every fact from the real tree and fails closed on drift. runtime_verified is false throughout: the C++ is compile-plausibility only and is compiled by CI, not here; no tab pixels or window switching are claimed.

reused_frame_raise_api.note: The load-bearing reuse. SfxDocumentTabBar::RaiseFrameForPage reuses the exact frame-activation pair the Window menu uses -- WindowListMenuController::itemSelected raises a document window with pWin->GrabFocus() then pWin->ToTop(ToTopFlags::RestoreWhenMin) after VCLUnoHelper::GetWindow(xFrame->getContainerWindow()). This raises an already-existing top-level window; it touches NO frame-topness seam and performs NO WorkWindow cast.

tabbar_subclass.note: The strip is a real svtools::TabBar subclass (not a bespoke widget), so it inherits the Material TabBar paint the Calc sheet-tabs already contract.

material_paint_ride.note: Same anatomy as ScTabControl in calc-sheet-tabs.json: tokens resolved from vcl::MaterialTokens over definition.xml, gated on VCL_FILE_WIDGET_THEME=material and NOT high contrast; the per-tab colour is held out of the base full-tab fill and drawn as an accent strip that never consults the selection state.

style_sourced_rendering.note: Every rendered attribute (label, colour, pin, favorite, order) comes from the persisted stage-2 SfxDocTabStyle, passed through SfxDocTabStyle::Normalize -- no hardcoded colour or label. The strip includes the stage-2 header and consults the DocumentTabStyles set keyed by document URL.

tabs_enabled_guard.note: The fail-closed construction guard. The static Create() factory is the only way to obtain a strip and returns nullptr unless TabsEnabled is true, so the widget cannot construct when tabs are off. TabsEnabled defaults false in the stage-2 officecfg group; when off the tabs-off path is byte-identical.

appearance_editor.note: The per-tab appearance editor reachable from the strip's right-click context menu. Weld dialog over the .ui; edits CustomLabel/colour/pin/favorite/font from the stage-2 schema and persists through officecfg, each value re-validated by the normalizer before write. gla11y-clean (0 FATALs).
